caption: The drawing consists of several outlined objects rendered in black lines on a light, off-white background. At the top center, there is a side view of a vessel with a curved handle on the left, a spout on the right, and a slight flare at the edges, labeled as "1." Above the right part of this vessel, an enlarged circular inset labeled "3" contains the outline of a cone and a small circle. Below the vessel, there is a separate circular object labeled "1A," featuring engraved or inscribed text with the words "MARK (ACTUAL SIZE)" beneath it. Lower on the page, a top view of the vessel is shown, labeled "2," with concentric circles and a centrally positioned handle extending leftward; this vessel occupies the middle portion of the page. To the right of this is another enlarged circular inset labeled "4," containing the outline of a spiral or tightly coiled line with a straight line through its center. At the bottom, a horizontal scale marked "Scale In Inches" runs from 0 to 4, with a note saying "(Except Mark)" beneath the scale. The objects are arranged with connecting dashed lines between the main silhouettes and the enlarged detail circles, and all elements are monochromatic, using only black lines on a beige background.
title: Candlestick with Snuffer
